description: Discrete 4-tier fact verification model preventing premature verification labeling.

tiers.guarantee: Source URL is located; bytes are unverified.
Official document bytes are cryptographically intact.

tiers.prerequisites: BYTE_VERIFIED + machine-readable text extracted with page bindings
tiers.guarantee: Official document text is machine-readable and searchable.
prohibitedConclusions: RULE_VERIFIED (until extracted text is mapped to formal ruleType)

tiers.prerequisites: TEXT_VERIFIED + mapped to canonical ruleType + backed by paragraphOrTableRef
tiers.guarantee: Specific eligibility or reservation criterion is fully verified against official source.

strictTransitionRules: RULE_VERIFIED requires TEXT_VERIFIED which requires BYTE_VERIFIED which requires SOURCE_LOCATED.
No tier skipping allowed: URL_FOUND can never yield RULE_VERIFIED.
Scanned PDF with verified SHA256 stops at BYTE_VERIFIED until OCR/transcription is cryptographically bound.
